name: Isolated Generalized Anhidrosis with Normal Sweat Glands
aliases: Primary Generalized Anhidrosis with Preserved Sweat Glands

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Diagnostic Criteria for Isolated Generalized Anhidrosis with Normal Sweat Glands

criteria.description: Generalized absence of sweating confirmed by clinical and functional testing
Histological examination demonstrating normal sweat gland morphology and density
Exclusion of secondary causes of anhidrosis such as neuropathies, skin disorders, or systemic diseases
Preserved autonomic nervous system function except for sweat production

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of generalized anhidrosis with normal sweat gland histology and exclusion of secondary causes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires multidisciplinary evaluation including dermatology, neurology, and pathology.

pathognomonic.notes: Complete lack of sweat production over the entire body surface

pathognomonic.symptomName: Heat intolerance due to impaired thermoregulation
pathognomonic.notes: Patients experience overheating during physical activity or warm environments

common.symptomName: Dry skin without signs of sweat gland atrophy
common.notes: Skin appears dry but sweat glands are histologically normal
searchTerms: dry skin without sweat gland loss

common.notes: Mild to moderate itching due to xerosis
Elevated core body temperature during heat exposure
searchTerms: episodes of mild high body temperature

common.notes: Tiredness following heat exposure or exertion

occasional.notes: Redness of skin in areas exposed to heat
Mild headaches during episodes of overheating
Elevated heart rate as compensatory response

rare.notes: Transient loss of consciousness due to heat stress

rare.symptomName: Secondary skin infections due to dry skin

laboratory: Normal serum electrolytes and metabolic panel
other: Normal sweat gland histology on skin biopsy
Normal autonomic function tests except absent sweating

distinguishingFeatures: Reduced number or absence of sweat glands on histology
Often associated with ectodermal dysplasia features
Abnormal autonomic function tests beyond sweat production
Congenital absence or hypoplasia of sweat glands

redFlags: Episodes of hyperthermia with altered mental status
Rapid onset of anhidrosis with systemic symptoms
Signs of autonomic failure beyond sweating abnormalities
references: Kono T, et al. Isolated generalized anhidrosis with normal sweat glands: clinical and histopathological features. J Dermatol. 2018;45(3):345-352.
